### Adding a meeting

1. Click **New** in the file sidebar and choose the **Team meeting** template.
2. Name the file `team-sync/2026-MM-DD.qmd`.
3. Add a link to it at the top of the Meetings list above.
4. Share the project link before the call, then type together.

The template lives in `_quarto-hub-templates/team-meeting.qmd`. Change the attendee list and the sections there to fit your team.

For an initial walkthrough of Quarto Hub itself, start with the [getting started guide](https://quarto-dev.github.io/quarto-hub/get-started.html).
